paper.title_en: Optical readout of MicroPattern Gaseous Detectors with SiPMs
paper.abstract_en: Scintillation light readout of MicroPattern Gaseous Detectors (MPGDs) is used for imaging and track reconstruction applications including in optical Time Projection Chambers (TPC). Typically, high resolution CCD or CMOS imaging sensors are used and PMTs can be employed to obtain auxiliary timing information. We report on the optical readout of MPGDs with Silicon Photomultipliers (SiPMs) which enables limited spatial resolution. Arrays of SiPMs were used to read out Gaseous Electron Multipliers (GEMs) and Glass Micromegas amplification stages. Center of gravity reconstruction of hit positions yields a spatial resolution of approximately 1.35 mm for signals shared across multiple SiPMs. High gain of the amplification stage as well as the SiPMs enables good signal sharing and is advantageous for position reconstruction.
